description: Zajętość storage groups (MF.STG.SPACE): dashboard na LPAR, panel na SGN, podsumowanie % na górze

panelQueries.query: SELECT mean("VAL") FROM "MF.STG.SPACE" WHERE "LPAR" = '{dashboard}' AND "SGN" = '{panel}' AND "MTYPE" = 'USED.GB' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("VAL") FROM "MF.STG.SPACE" WHERE "LPAR" = '{dashboard}' AND "SGN" = '{panel}' AND "MTYPE" = 'USED.PER' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("VAL") FROM "MF.STG.SPACE" WHERE "LPAR" = '{dashboard}' AND "SGN" = '{panel}' AND "MTYPE" = 'TOTAL.GB' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

extraQueries.query: SELECT mean("VAL") * 0.9 FROM "MF.STG.SPACE" WHERE {where} AND "MTYPE" = 'TOTAL.GB' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

queries.alert: SELECT last("VAL") FROM "MF.STG.SPACE" WHERE "LPAR" = '{dashboard}' AND "MTYPE" = 'USED.PER' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SGN"
